mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of cases when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases when UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts reflect weaker demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: If HOUST decline does not correlate with negative SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production growth signals supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth slowdown does not predict negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth indicates robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If GDP growth does not correlate with positive SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate alongside low unemployment indicates tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the joint condition does not predict negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales and employment indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the joint increase does not predict positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation rise in late-cycle expansion may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If CPI rise does not predict negative returns in late-cycle.
